searchText: We are not planning currently to implement signing on prysm. I'm advocating so that the `staking-cli` or similar app to get a signed message offline that the beacon can broadcast via an endpoint. We don't want users messing with their mnemonics online Indeed. I wish we had a common tool like that for exits too. There’s no need for each client to have to support creating them. would be cool if it can get broadcasted through the launchpad, so entering + exiting is in one place I'd rather have the one place be your own client pair then I talked to Carl before about this when we started implementing cause I wanted to more or less fix the JSON format so that we could start testing without mocking this tool. He seemed as he could be convinced of extending his tool to cover this case, so I suggest we exercise enough peer pressure 🤣 this may result in uneccassary slashings if users want to only exit a specific validator for example. Preferably there is a GUI solution for this.. Not sure what you mean by slashings, what would get them slashed? And I mostly meant the broadcasting system to be the client pair (instead of the launchpad), with a cli like staking-cli (or ethdo) providing the functionality to get the appropriate signed messages. k , missunderstood your msg

excerpts.content: We are not planning currently to implement signing on prysm. I'm advocating so that the `staking-cli` or similar app to get a signed message offline that the beacon can broadcast via an endpoint. We don't want users messing with their mnemonics online
